name: Marry Me Chicken
description: Golden seared chicken cutlets simmered in a creamy Parmesan sauce with sun-dried tomatoes, garlic, thyme and chili flakes, finished with basil. Serves 4.

ingredients.text: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 700 g), halved horizontally into cutlets
ingredients.item: large boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 700 g), halved horizontally into cutlets

ingredients.text: 1 tsp fresh thyme leaves (or 1/2 tsp dried oregano)
ingredients.item: fresh thyme leaves (or 1/2 tsp dried oregano)

steps.text: Season 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 700 g), halved horizontally into cutlets with 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper and dust lightly with 2 tbsp all-purpose flour.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Sear the chicken 4 minutes per side, until golden and nearly cooked through. Transfer to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium and melt 2 tbsp butter. Add 4 garlic cloves, minced, 1 tsp fresh thyme leaves (or 1/2 tsp dried oregano), 1/2 tsp red chili flakes and 1/2 tsp paprika and stir 1 minute.

Pour in 180 ml chicken stock, scraping up the browned bits, and simmer 2 minutes. Add 240 ml heavy cream and 60 g oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, chopped and simmer 3 minutes, until slightly thickened. Stir in 40 g Parmigiano-Reggiano, finely grated.
Return the chicken and its juices and simmer 4 minutes, spooning the sauce over, until the chicken is 74°C inside.
Scatter with 10 g basil leaves, torn and serve with pasta, rice or crusty bread.

notes: Slicing the breasts into thin cutlets means they cook through in the time it takes to brown, so they stay juicy. A spoonful of the sun-dried tomato oil in place of some of the olive oil deepens the flavor.
